newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Britain's Prince Charles meets Bahrain's Emir.
newsitem.headline: Britain's Prince Charles meets Bahrain's Emir.

text.p: Britain's Prince Charles held talks on Monday with Bahrain's Emir Sheikh Isa bin Sulman al-Khalifa on relations with the Gulf Arab state.
"We are very proud of our friendship with the British...We would like to be close to each other," Sheikh Isa told Prince Charles, a source close to the talks said.

The Gulf News Agency quoted Sheikh Isa as saying Bahrain "looks forward to strengthening its friendship and cooperation with Britain". He praised British efforts to maintain security in the Gulf, the agency said.
Britain was part of a U.S.-led coalition that ended Iraq's occupation of Kuwait in 1991. British warships in the Gulf are part of a multinational effort enforcing sanctions on Iraq.

Prince Charles arrived in the former British protectorate aboard the royal yacht Britannia earlier in the day. He sailed from Kuwait on Saturday night aboard the 6,000-tonne yacht, which is on its final voyage before it is taken out of service after 44 years.
Bahrain's Prime Minister Sheikh Khalifa bin Sulman al-Khalifa and Prince Charles on Monday inaugurated the British Design Excellence exhibition at the Le Royal Meridien hotel.
Prince Charles is due to sail to Qatar tonight.
